provider_name: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
access_description: Public Board H.15 Data Download zip. No key. Series H15/H15/RIFSPFF_N.M is the monthly federal funds effective rate, per cent per year, bound only after the downloaded file repeated that series name, the long description, monthly frequency, and the per-cent-per-year unit. The daily business-day series is not stored.
auth_requirement: No key is described for the public H.15 download package.
conditions: Cite the Board. Do not use Board seals or logos. Copying covers Board information; the disclaimer still requires permission for non-Board photos, graphics, and trademarks. Do not present this level as a near-term forward spread.
revision_behaviour: The downloaded file is the current latest-revised package. It does not carry a historical vintage for each month, so these rows are not a vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. This series is not a near-term forward spread.
unresolved_questions: The disclaimer does not discuss AI processing or model training, so those decisions stay unknown. The package does not state a seasonal adjustment, so the stored seasonal adjustment is unknown. The file header says the Data Download Program build tool is due to be removed in the week of 9 November 2026 and points users to FRED. This row does not use FRED, because FRED retention is prohibited. Whether this zip address will remain after that week is not stated.
evidence_note: On 22 October 2026 the Board H.15 zip returned HTTP 200. Inside H15_data.xml, DataSet id H15 and schema H15_H15, the series repeats H15/H15/RIFSPFF_N.M: SERIES_NAME RIFSPFF_N.M, FREQ 129 (Monthly), UNIT Percent:_Per_Year (Percent: Per Year), and long description 'Federal funds effective rate'. The package is one latest-revised file, not a vintage panel. This series is not a near-term forward spread. ND is an omitted period: the package encodes it as OBS_STATUS ND and OBS_VALUE -9999, and that sentinel is not stored as zero. The daily business-day series is not stored. The Board disclaimer, read on 22 October 2026, says that unless otherwise indicated, information on Board's website is in the public domain and may be copied and distributed without permission, and it asks users to cite the Board. It does not discuss AI processing or model training. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume these dataset ids. Sahm and PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE require bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. This dataset id is fed.h15.RIFSPFF_N.M.
